shared_elements: horizontal bands of incised lines or registers
justification: Both are eroded stone surfaces bearing shallow relief organised into stacked horizontal zones, with a prominent disc-like element and stylised figural forms in the upper part of each. But A is a freestanding three-dimensional anthropomorphic monolith whose carvings wrap a sculpted body, while B is a flat rock panel with a small figural register above a large field of dense inscribed lines, so the compositional logic and rendering are quite different.
